integrity cross-check against an independent second mirror (sha256):
  - rock_face_02.bin and textures/rock_face_02_{diff,nor_gl,arm}_1k.jpg: MATCH sha256 vs the independent copy at
    https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/Mainframe-Games/mainframe-engine/main/Examples/Forest/Assets/Art/Props/rock_face_02/ (Git LFS)
  - rock_face_02_1k.gltf: that Mainframe-Games copy has an EDITED .gltf (adds occlusionTexture, renames image 'rough'->'arm');
    the copy staged here is the unmodified Blender-exporter .gltf (images named *_rough as in every other Poly Haven 1k export).

intended use: SM_Rock_C (tall rock ~4 m) - PRIMARY. Upright layered rock pillar with yellow-green lichen, 2.5 m tall -> scale x1.6. 29.6k tris (decimate to 15k).

tech notes (verified 2026-10-28):
  rock_face_02_1k.gltf: Blender 5.2 glTF import OK, missing images: 0; 29,566 tris; 1 mesh object(s); bbox (m, X/Y/Z-up) [2.711, 2.127, 2.472]; materials ['rock_face_02']; textures: rock_face_02_diff 1024x1024, rock_face_02_nor_gl 1024x1024, rock_face_02_rough 1024x1024
  Normal map is OpenGL (+Y) -> tick "Flip Green Channel" in UE. *_arm_1k.jpg packs R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic (linear, sRGB off).
  Origin is not at base-centre/-Y-front per catalog convention: re-pivot in the dai pipeline.
  Over the ~15k-tri budget for a non-Nanite mesh. Tested recipe (Blender 5.2): import glTF -> bmesh remove_doubles(dist=1e-5)
  (Poly Haven exports are split at every UV seam; without welding, Decimate stalls at ~40% of the input) -> Decimate COLLAPSE
  ratio = target/tris. boulder_01 66,122 -> 15,000 tris was visually indistinguishable at prop distance. Or keep full res for Nanite.
